query:
SELECT
                f.id,
                f.name,
                f.created_at,
                COUNT(fr.resource_id) as resource_count
            FROM favorites f
            LEFT JOIN favorite_resources fr ON f.id = fr.favorite_id
            WHERE f.user_id = $1
            GROUP BY f.id, f.name, f.created_at
            ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
